scope: Seven bounded research questions and 17 scoped mappings. Five new questions passed primary-source curation and separate automated cross-review, with 14 new mappings to 51 existing evaluations. Both original questions, all three original mappings and all 26,124 baseline records are preserved. No new scientific result or source record is introduced.
limitations: Automated source curation and cross-review are not human scientific review or independent experimental replication.
No positive clinical suitability claim is supported.
Metric and split groups can share configurations and experimental provenance; 57 evaluation references do not mean 57 independent studies.
Undefined control correlations, unreported uncertainty and missing provenance remain explicit; no model-family winner or prospective experimental yield is established.
The AMFR matched singles comparison remains planned and execution-blocked.
Evidence fingerprints are explicitly frozen during curation; release generation only checks them.
